SalesforceConfig._note: Deployment-level settings only. Org credentials are managed through the API and stored encrypted in the App Database; nothing org-specific belongs here.
SalesforceConfig._ApiVersionNote: Platform event channel management needs 47.0 or later; 56.0 for member filter expressions, 60.0 for the External Client App certificate field, 61.0 for channel EventType.
SalesforceConfig._PubSubEndpointNote: Correct for sandbox and production alike. Change it only for EU data-residency orgs: https://api.deu.pubsub.salesforce.com:7443
SalesforceConfig._CallbackUrlNote: Register this exact value on the External Client App. Salesforce requires https, with localhost the only exception.

DataProtection._note: Where to find the certificate that protects the Data Protection key ring. These name locations, never key material. The application will not generate this certificate for itself: a protecting key it minted and stored beside the data it protects would protect nothing.

ProtectingCertificate._EnvironmentVariableNote: Holds a base64-encoded PFX. Tried first.
ProtectingCertificate._FilePathNote: Path to a PFX file. Tried second.
ProtectingCertificate._KeyManagementServiceKeyIdNote: Tried last. Not implemented yet; a configured value is reported as an error rather than ignored.
